missions.description: Travel to Procyon to collect overdue Federation debts in platinum ore from the Solarian colony.

dialog.offer: The Federation Revenue Service has three overdue accounts that have resisted every standard collection method. Polite reminders, escalation notices, frozen trade credentials — nothing. I need someone who can physically travel to each debtor and collect. First stop: Procyon Colonial Station. The Solarian Confederacy's Procyon colony owes the Federation for a bulk fuel shipment they received six months ago. They claim budget shortfalls. I claim they have asteroid belts full of platinum. Collect 10 units of platinum ore as payment in kind.

objectives.description: Collect platinum ore payment from Procyon

missions.title: Overdue Accounts

missions.description: The Nebula Trade Federation is commissioning a comprehensive survey of all Federation stations for a new trade route investment prospectus. Visit every station in Federation space and return with market data.

dialog.offer: The Federation is preparing an investment prospectus for a new generation of optimized trade routes, and we need current data from every station in our network. Market Prime, Cargo Lanes, Gold Run, Factory Belt, Trader's Rest, Treasure Cache, and the Levy — each one a link in the chain that makes the Federation the economic engine of settled space. Dock at each station, let your ship's sensors log the commercial traffic patterns, and bring the full dataset back here. The commission on this contract is generous, because the data is worth ten times what we're paying you.

objectives.description: Return to Grand Exchange with survey data

missions.title: Federation Trade Route Prospectus

missions.description: Chart nearby star systems to update our navigation databases. Every system you visit helps.

dialog.offer: Our navigation charts are getting stale. If you visit 3 systems I haven't had recent data from, I'll pay for the survey results.

missions.title: Local Sector Survey

missions.description: The salvage yard foreman needs someone to tow in a wreck. A good way to learn the business.

dialog.offer: New to salvaging? Here's how it works. Wrecks are scattered across the galaxy — left behind after battles, pirate attacks, equipment failures. Fit a tow rig module in a utility slot, fly to a wreck, use tow_wreck to attach it, then haul it back here. I'll buy it off you. Simple as that.

objectives.description: Sell 1 wreck at a salvage yard

missions.title: First Haul

missions.description: Visit all five empire capital systems and return to Haven in the longest route through civilized space.

dialog.offer: The Nebula Collective believes that commerce thrives on connection, and connection requires understanding. I'm commissioning a Grand Tour — one pilot, five empires, every capital visited. Sol, Nexus, Krynn, Haven, and Frontier. You'll carry a Nebula trade charter, which identifies you as a diplomatic observer. It won't stop pirates, but it will open doors at every capital. Visit all five systems and return here. The longest route in civilized space, and one of the most rewarding.

missions.title: Grand Tour of the Five Empires

missions.description: Establish the first links of the Grand Circuit trade route by delivering inaugural shipments to Market Prime and Cargo Lanes.

dialog.offer: The Commerce Bureau is establishing a galaxy-spanning trade route — the Grand Circuit. Every major market connected by a single optimized shipping lane. But a route on paper is worthless. We need inaugural shipments to prove the lanes are viable. Start here at Grand Exchange: load up refined copper wire and deliver it to Market Prime, then extend the run to Cargo Lanes with a shipment of nickel ore. Two stops, two deliveries, and the first links in the Circuit are forged.

objectives.description: Deliver refined copper wire to Market Prime
Deliver nickel ore to Cargo Lanes

missions.title: First Links

missions.description: Deliver refined circuits from Nebula space to Sirius Observatory for astronomical research.

dialog.offer: The Nebula Collective and the Solarian Confederacy share a mutual interest in astronomical research, and the Sirius Observatory is conducting experiments that require refined circuits we manufacture here in Nebula space. Ten units, delivered to Sirius Observatory. It's a cross-border delivery through relatively well-traveled space, but the lawless corridors between empires always carry risk. The Academic Exchange covers shipping costs and hazard compensation.

objectives.description: Deliver 10 Refined Circuits to Sirius Observatory

missions.title: Nebula-Sol Research Materials

missions.description: The station needs a steady supply of iron ore to maintain its infrastructure. Mine some and bring it back.

dialog.offer: We're running low on iron ore again. If you can mine 30 units and bring them back, I'll make it worth your while.

missions.title: Iron Supply Run

missions.description: Hunt down a pirate threatening local shipping lanes. Any pirate will do - the station pays for confirmed kills.

dialog.offer: We've got pirates disrupting trade in the region and the station is posting bounties. Take one out and bring proof. Use the `attack` command when you find one - pirates tend to spawn in lawless systems with low police presence. Fair warning: they shoot back, so watch your hull.

missions.title: Pirate Bounty

missions.description: Every trader starts somewhere. Mine copper ore for the Exchange's electronics workshops — your first step into the galaxy's greatest market.

dialog.offer: Welcome to the Grand Exchange, Captain. Haven is the beating heart of galactic commerce, and we're always looking for reliable suppliers. Start small — mine 15 units of copper ore for the electronics workshops. Show us you can deliver.

missions.title: First Cargo

missions.description: Place buy orders on the station exchange to learn how the market works. Any items count.

dialog.offer: The exchange runs on supply and demand, and right now we need more demand. Place some buy orders - any items, any quantity, as long as you buy at least 10 units total. Use the `create_buy_order` command to place an order on the book. Your orders sit there until a seller fills them, or you can cancel.

objectives.description: Buy 10 units of any item on the exchange

missions.title: Market Participation: Buying

missions.description: Break Admiral Kael's tier 2 pirate blockade choking trade through the Xamidimura system.

dialog.offer: Admiral Kael's forces have established a stronghold in the Xamidimura system, and they're choking trade through the sector. These aren't novice raiders — Kael runs a professional operation with tier two combat vessels. We need three of them eliminated to break the blockade. The Nebula Collective is offering premium bounties because our trade routes depend on it.

missions.title: Xamidimura Interdiction

missions.description: Titanium is in high demand for hull plating. Mine a batch from the local asteroid belts.

dialog.offer: Titanium prices are through the roof and our suppliers can't keep up. Willing to pay premium rates for 20 units of titanium ore.

missions.title: Titanium Extraction Contract

missions.description: Copper ore is essential for electronics manufacturing. Mine a batch for the station workshops.

dialog.offer: My workshop is backed up waiting on copper. If you can bring me 25 units of copper ore, I can get the production lines moving again.

missions.title: Copper Requisition

missions.description: List items for sale on the station exchange. Any items count toward the goal.

dialog.offer: The exchange needs sellers as much as buyers. List some items for sale - at least 10 units of anything. Use the `create_sell_order` command to put items on the market. There's a small listing fee, but the returns are worth it when buyers come knocking.

objectives.description: Sell 10 units of any item on the exchange

missions.title: Market Participation: Selling

missions.description: Foreman Voss has heard rumors of hidden mineral deposits deep in lawless space. He needs an experienced miner to help investigate.

dialog.offer: I've spent years studying geological survey data from the frontier, and I'm convinced there are massive mineral deposits hidden in lawless space — deposits too deep for standard scanners to detect. I need a veteran miner to help me prove it. Mine 20 units of platinum ore — I need the platinum for calibrating prototype detection equipment. You'll need mining_advanced experience for this kind of work.

missions.title: Deep Core Prospecting
